Furthermore, I have a 3:1 port at node 50, so I can potentially convert my excess Wood or other resources later. Claude is a direct competitor and currently has 3 Sheep; giving him Ore might help him build a City or buy Development Cards (he already has 2 Knights). Since I am so close to winning, I should keep my Ore. Accepting this trade doesn't bring me closer to the win condition and helps a rival.
